# Storystak AI

> Storystak AI is a B2B consulting service that builds custom AI systems for companies of 10–100 employees. We encode senior team expertise (frameworks, voice, decision-making) into AI infrastructure so junior team members can produce senior-level output without adding headcount.

## What we do

We build the operational layer that sits between the AI tools a company already has (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) and the team that uses them. Most companies that have tried AI report that pilots didn't stick or output sounded generic — the issue is almost always missing infrastructure, not missing tools. BCG calls this the 70% (people, processes, organizational readiness); the tools and models are only 30% of the equation.

A typical Storystak engagement runs 6 weeks and produces:

- Custom AI workspaces configured with the client's voice, processes, and decision criteria
- Knowledge files containing SOPs, brand standards, product details, and institutional knowledge
- A reusable prompt library (25–30 prompts) organized by function
- Workflow templates for high-volume recurring work
- An AI Playbook documenting how to use, extend, and onboard people into the system
- Live training sessions plus recorded walkthroughs for future hires

## Outcomes clients see

- 9 hours reclaimed per person per week (BCG research on AI super-users vs. laggards)
- 51 working days per person per year previously lost to technology friction
- 4x team output without adding headcount
- $138K–$414K in annual value recovered from a single engagement (typical range for a 10-person team)
- 7–14x return on a single engagement in year one

## Pricing

- **Free Discovery Call** — $0, 30 minutes with the founder, honest advice on the client's specific situation
- **Departmental Engagement** — $7,500, one team (Marketing, Sales, or Operations), 4 weeks, complete system for that department
- **Full Engagement** — $20,000, all departments, 6 weeks, cross-departmental integration
- **Monthly Retainer (optional)** — $1,500/month, ongoing optimization and new module builds

## How we differ from typical AI consulting

We build working systems, not workshops or strategy decks. The day we leave, the team is already using the systems we installed. Specifically:

- We are operators, not advisors
- We ship working infrastructure, not slide decks
- We do not sell software or build custom code requiring engineers to maintain
- We install systems on tools the team already uses (Claude Team, ChatGPT, etc.)
- We are not a generalist AI agency; we specialize in encoding expertise
